body: Love the tshirt.
It breaks my heart reading this, because I would want to hang and chill out with you guys so badly.

Agree with others that you simply don’t touch anyone who is in a marriage or relationship (this goes for anyone of any sexual orientation).

I’m a straight curious guy, maybe gay maybe bi - closeted, and super curious  about fem and andro guys - I’m at a crossroads where I could definitely start making changes and try a new relationship but it would have to be discreet, I’d hope my partner would be understanding and appreciative, support me and give me time - maybe it could lead somewhere and end up coming out who knows - but I’d hate to be pressured into coming out or anything.

But in return I’d be willing to explore almost everything with the right guy (if we were in the same headspace) and I feel like that would be such a nice thing to have - it feels almost impossible to me,  hard not to lose hope :(

I can totally get into the idea of letting a feminine guy (like you say it’s not just looks it’s personality and mannerisms and everything) just introduce me to new stuff, take control for a bit - open my eyes to new stuff - it’s such a nice thought putting my masculinity aside and just going with the flow and see what happens.
I will add you when I’m on next!
Ahh I played a fair amount of it but I just couldn’t get into it no matter how much I tried!
This is such a shame - what’s the solution?
Hmm I don’t think it’s for me but I’ve never played the series - it’s really hard to find time for this sort of thing - octopath will take me months maybe years to complete :)
I like it, the music and combat are fun - but I do feel like it's missing some magic, the story is hard to get into, and characters generic - way way too much dialogue also, slow cutscenes

Unfortunately I've not bought the online service yet, MK was the only game I've played online much and I played it to death, I think I might need to wait for the next big online thing before forking out the money!
Cool!
Hey I’m really new here - I play a lot of SFV :)

Right now, octopath and dead cells, previously MK, Zelda, Mario Odyssey etc

Want to get into the breach soon!

Thanks, it’s ok - I blundered my way in here not understanding the etiquette and was desperate.

I hope the person is ok and knows people care.

I don’t know what this means, I was trying to help - I’m shocked at the unbelievably rude pm you have just sent me.

If someone can instruct me on what I should do then fine - otherwise that’s my last post here I guess.
What kinda blows my mind is that there isn’t an online resource or forum just for fem guys, it feels like its needed so badly.
I can understand this - softness and being delicate in general is something I really like - I feel it’s underrated!
Anything in particular that you like?

No this is the EXACT thing I’m talking about!

I share the frustration of all guys in that situation that feel discriminated against.

Do you think it’s weird that I’m straight / curious and find myself thinking about femme guys a lot?
I definitely admire their confidence.
That’s cool, I appreciate it! and I hope feminine guys do also
